title: Model ML Partners with Dun & Bradstreet to Bring Trusted Business Data and Risk Intelligence Into Every Workflow
body_markdown:
Model ML today announced our partnership with Dun & Bradstreet, bringing D&B's trusted business data and risk intelligence into Model ML.


Dun & Bradstreet provides the context layer for enterprise AI - helping organizations establish trusted business identity, unify critical data assets, and continuously govern information across systems, workflows, and AI environments. Built on the D&B Commercial Graph™ and anchored by the D‑U‑N‑S® Number, D&B delivers trusted firmographics, corporate hierarchies, ownership, and credit risk intelligence on hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.


Through the MCP, Model ML users can retrieve Dun & Bradstreet company profiles, risk scores, and ownership data directly into the Model ML platform where they're already working. No need to log into a separate portal or manually cross-reference reports.


By grounding agents and workflows in trusted business context, teams can support faster, more reliable counterparty due diligence, risk screening, and company research; all without leaving the Model ML platform.


Now available to Model ML users with an active Dun & Bradstreet subscription today.
